name: What should I do if my tankless water heater displays an error code?

mainEntity.name: What should I do if my tankless water heater displays an error code?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your tankless water heater displays an error code, consult your owner's manual first, as it often provides specific troubleshooting steps for that code. Sometimes, a simple reset can resolve the issue. If the problem persists after basic troubleshooting, it indicates a more serious internal issue. It's crucial to contact a professional for diagnosis and repair to avoid further damage. We recommend shutting off the unit's power until a technician arrives to prevent potential safety hazards or additional system stress.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check your manual for error code troubleshooting; a reset might work. If not, shut off power and call a professional for diagnosis to prevent further damage.
